description: Reads your account's audit log, newest first, across every resource: events (what was done to a resource, by a user or by the platform, such as sandbox.create or sandbox.spend_cap_delete: the events webhooks deliver) and requests (each create, change and delete sent to the API, with its method, path and HTTP status, failed attempts included). Each item: id, kind, at, action, resource {type, id}, actor {type: user or platform, username}, outcome, and for a request {method, path, status}. Filter by kind (event or request), action (one action, or a prefix such as sandbox.*), resource_type (such as sandbox), and since and until (ISO 8601 times). Read it in pages: limit 1 to 200 (50 by default), then each answer's next_cursor as cursor, with the same filters. It is not a sandbox's own log of its commands and connections (get_sandbox_audit_log). Reading changes nothing. Any API key that reads works (audit:list, read or '*').

action.description: Optional: one action, such as "sandbox.create", or a prefix, such as "sandbox.*".

cursor.description: Optional: the next_cursor of the last answer, to read the page after it (with the same filters).

kind.description: Optional: "event" for what was done to resources, "request" for what was sent to the API. Left out, both.

limit.description: Optional: items in a page, 1 to 200 (50 when left out).

resource_type.description: Optional: only items about this type of resource, such as "sandbox" (for a request, the first segment of its path, such as "sandboxes").

since.description: Optional: only items at or after this ISO 8601 time, e.g. "2026-11-22T00:00:00Z".

until.description: Optional: only items before this ISO 8601 time.

name: get_audit_log
title: Read your account's audit log
